name: craft_beers
label: Craft brewery and beer names
provenance: Wave-1 WS-1 batch 2, added 2026-07-24 on branch claude/next-three-items-nj7dyj. US and international craft beer and brewery names recalled from general knowledge - descriptive (IPA, Porter, Stout), whimsical (Hoppy Beer, Belly Dance) and branded (Stone IPA, Founders All Day); no brewery database was consulted. Digits are fine (90 Minute), but 18 of 398 lines carry 17 apostrophes (Bell's Two Hearted) plus one umlaut, which scripts/check_data.py grandfathers pending normalisation by the data-cleanup lane.
